title: 第16章 暗处的杀手
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
离开茶州城，陆舟一行人继续往南。

    相较于一马平川的北方，大周的南方则多丘陵山地，地形复杂。

    行至一处溪涧旁，夜色渐暗，刘傲勒住马，高声吩咐就地扎营。

    陆舟下马车后，闲来无事便走到溪边，玩起了打水漂。

    他掂量着手中石子，只觉掌心气血奔涌，隐隐积蓄着一股磅礴之力。

    这一路上，还剩下几十万两白银的他，顺势将买下的《八荒破灭诀》和《雷音轰》一并学会了。

    两门五品武技，也让他对身体力量的控制臻于化境。

    噗——

    石子贴着水面轻快弹出，一路往下，弹跳了足足二十多次才停下。

    力量的掌控，影响的是方方面面。

    陆舟会心一笑。

    突然。

    他感知到一股隐晦的窥探感悄然袭来！

    他神色微凝，骤然侧目，望向一旁密林。

    林间，晚风吹拂，枝叶轻摇，看似平静。

    但陆舟很确信，有人在窥视自己！

    只因玄元内力不仅仅能够在战斗中赋予更强大的威能，同时也能增强肉身强度，强化感知。

    难道又是京城的刺客？！

    “王爷，营帐搭好了。”就在这时，李雄来到身边，躬身禀报。

    陆舟收回视线，淡淡应了一声。

    不管是何人窥探，他心底已经打定主意，决意引蛇出洞。

    随后，陆舟来到自己的营帐。

    营帐内。

    地毡和褥垫已经铺好，简易案几上还点燃着油灯，将帐内照得通亮。

    陆舟微微颔首。

    有人照顾确实不一样。

    帘布轻掀，一道纤细身影缓步走入帐中。

    “王爷，该用膳了！”

    端着食盘的柳仙儿，步履轻盈，俯身将餐食一一摆上案几，动作细致，语气温顺轻柔。

    摆好饭菜，她又贴心为陆舟斟上温水，才退到一旁。

    陆舟愈发满意。

    遥想先前，风餐露宿，每天就是大饼配热汤，简直就不是自己这王爷该过的日子。

    用膳期间，他还不忘思考先前窥探之人的事，正盘算着如何钓鱼执法才是。

    毕竟那人既然能被自己发现，估计实力也就那样。

    自己刚刚掌控了一门功法和三门武技，正愁没办法实战演练一下呢。

    不过，不能惊动其他人。

    等用完膳，柳仙儿神情恭顺，轻声询问：“王爷，您还有什么需要的吗？”

    “没了，你先下去吧。”陆舟摇头。

    说罢，柳仙儿便温顺退下。
content_en:
After leaving Chazhou City, Lu Zhou and his party continued south.

    Compared with the flat plains in the north, the southern part of Dazhou is hilly and mountainous, with complex terrain.

    When they reached a stream, the night was getting dark. Liu Ao reined in his horse and loudly ordered to set up camp on the spot.

    After Lu Zhou got off the carriage, he walked to the stream and played with water.

    He weighed the stones in his hands and felt the blood rushing through his palms, faintly accumulating a majestic force.

    Along the way, he still had hundreds of thousands of taels of silver left, so he took advantage of the situation and learned the "Eight Desolations Destruction Technique" and "Thunder Sound Boom" together.

    Two fifth-level martial arts skills also allowed him to control his body's strength to a perfect level.

    Poof——

    The pebbles bounced briskly against the water's surface, bouncing all the way down for more than twenty times before stopping.

    The control of power affects every aspect.

    Lu Zhou smiled knowingly.

    Sudden.

    He felt a vague sense of spying coming quietly!

    His expression was slightly condensed, and he suddenly looked sideways at the dense forest.

    In the forest, the evening breeze blows and the branches and leaves sway gently, seemingly peaceful.

    But Lu Zhou was convinced that someone was spying on him!

    Just because Xuanyuan's internal power can not only give more powerful power in battle, but also enhance the strength of the physical body and enhance perception.

    Could it be another assassin from the capital? !

    "Your Majesty, the tent is set up." At this moment, Li Xiong came to his side and bowed to report.

    Lu Zhou looked away and responded lightly.

    No matter who was spying on him, he had already made up his mind and was determined to lure the snake out of its hole.

    Later, Lu Zhou came to his tent.

    Inside the tent.

    The carpet and mattress have been laid out, and the oil lamp is lit on the simple desk, illuminating the tent.

    Lu Zhou nodded slightly.

    It does make a difference having someone to take care of you.

    The curtain was lightly lifted, and a slender figure slowly walked into the tent.

    "Your Majesty, it's time to eat!"

    Liu Xian'er, who was holding the food plate, walked lightly and leaned over to place the meals on the table one by one. Her movements were meticulous and her voice was gentle and gentle.

    After setting the food, she thoughtfully poured warm water for Lu Zhou before stepping aside.

    Lu Zhou became more and more satisfied.

    Thinking back to the past, sleeping in the open air, eating flatbread and hot soup every day, it was simply not the life that a prince like him should live.

    During the meal, he did not forget to think about the people who spied on him earlier, and was thinking about how to fish and enforce the law.

    After all, since that person can be discovered by himself, his strength is probably about that.

    I have just mastered one martial art and three martial arts skills, and I am worried that I will not be able to practice them in actual combat.

    However, other people cannot be alarmed.

    After finishing the meal, Liu Xianer looked respectful and asked softly: "My lord, is there anything else you need?"

    "No, you go down first." Lu Zhou shook his head.

    After saying that, Liu Xianer meekly withdrew.
title_en: Chapter 16 The Killer in the Dark
